g.text: Whisper runners on Apple Silicon, one clip
One 935s clip (n=1), M2 Ultra, language set to ja, load and warm-up excluded, runs serialized. mlx = mlx-whisper, cpp = whisper.cpp 1.9.5 (Metal), fw = faster-whisper 1.2.1 (CPU only), v3 = large-v3.
